environment.timing_method: CUDA-event batched per-pass average of the captured plan; 30 fresh-process samples per arm, each from 10 replays x 3 trunk passes after 20 warmup replays.
environment.methodology: Fresh-process paired A/B sampling with fixed ABBA/BAAB blocks, 20 warmup replays, 30 samples of 10 replays x 3 trunk passes, integer timing-case identities, and separate paired/order-effect summaries. No threshold or automatic performance pass is applied.

protocol.methodology: Two ABBA/BAAB four-process blocks per case; each fresh process contributes 30 samples (10 replays per sample, 3 trunk passes per replay) and one process median. Order effects and paired deltas are preserved separately.

decision.methodology: Sixteen cases, two balanced blocks (ABBA then BAAB with reversed case order), four fresh process medians per arm per case. Each process uses 20 warmups and 30 CUDA-event samples, each normalized from 10 graph replays of three trunk passes. Review process and paired-block effects; do not treat individual replays as independent experiments.
decision.rationale: Accept the measured latency cost as an explicit tradeoff for shared implementations and corrected split-result publication. All 128 processes completed; no incomplete attempt contributes data. This is a whole-build comparison on one SM120 device, not evidence of zero overhead or isolated wrapper cost. Original toolchain provenance is incomplete.
